name: Ero Ero Yuuenchi e Youkoso! ~Kore ga Uwasa no Sex Attraction!?~
original_name: エロエロ遊園地へようこそ! ～コレが噂のセックスアトラクション!?～
source:
* Fun has never felt better! Step right into a carnival of dream-like delights! *

Yuya was an ordinary young boy with a usual crush on his childhood friend Haruna.
But due to his indecisiveness and her spontaneity they never became more.

He wasn't really happy about that, and one day things changed.
Yuya bought tickets to an amusement park that was veiled in mystery.
It was risky. The sort of risky that was good for friends to celebrate a birthday.

"This is my chance! Maybe we'll get closer from this!"

With the long-desired hope to share his feelings, Yuya invited Haruna.
But she threw a wrench into things without realizing when she invited her
twin imouto Natsuna as well. It became a trio date.

Will Yuya be able to confess his love now!?

* Welcome to the wonderland of male dreams!
For those who wish they could date that special someone!
For those who want romantic sex with the girl they yearn for!
Enjoy sex with the cute young girl as you play in Ero Ero Amusement Park!
Revel in the attractions, parades and X-X-X-citement!
